_meta.purpose: Structure of generated CVs and cover letters.
_meta.spec_note: The original spec's section 15 (cover letter structure) and section 24 (QC agent) were not supplied. The five-part structure below is DERIVED from standard cover-letter practice. Edit freely.
_meta.hard_rule: Every generated block must carry a source_ref pointing into data/master_cv.json. A block with no source_ref is a fabrication by definition and the QC agent fails the document.

parts.label: Opening - who you are and what you are applying for
may_not_contain: claims about the company beyond what the posting says

parts.label: Why this role - the match
must_contain: at least two skills that Phase 3 matched between the posting and the master CV
may_not_contain: skills the candidate does not have

parts.label: Evidence - a concrete achievement
must_contain: at least one achievement drawn from x_achievements with usable_in_applications = true
may_not_contain: any figure not present in the master CV

parts.label: Fit - transferable skills and honest positioning
must_contain: either a transferable-skill bridge from the skill gap, or a statement of relevant domain experience
may_not_contain: a claim to a skill listed as missing

parts.label: Close - availability and next step
may_not_contain: a start date, notice period or salary figure that is not recorded in x_preferences

parts.label: Opening - the programme, from the posting
Direction - your own summary of what you do
Evidence - a confirmed achievement or role
Close - a next step and your contact details

tailoring_rules: Reorder work highlights so those matching the posting's required skills appear first. Never reword a highlight to include a skill it did not already demonstrate.
Select at most max_highlights_per_role highlights per role, dropping the least relevant. Dropping is allowed; inventing is not.
Order key_skills by whether the posting asked for them.
The summary is assembled from master CV sentences only. It is not rewritten for each job.

checks.description: A block with no source_ref, or a source_ref that does not resolve to a path in master_cv.json.
Uses an achievement whose usable_in_applications is false.
Contains a numeric claim that does not appear anywhere in master_cv.json. This is the main fabrication detector - invented metrics are the highest-risk failure mode.
Claims a skill that is not in the master CV's skill keywords.
Uses a claim whose master record has verified = false. Allowed - a CV is self-reported by nature - but reported so it is never invisible.
States or implies current employment while master_cv marks the end date UNCONFIRMED.
A cover letter part defined above is absent or empty.

qc.numeric_tolerance_note: QC3 compares numerals found in generated text against every numeral present in master_cv.json. Years, counts and percentages that appear in the posting rather than the master CV are also allowed, since quoting the employer's own requirement back is not a claim about the candidate.
